$comment: Official enemy effect bindings (EN client battle/enm_pfb_*.ab, [uc]projectiles.ab, config/buff_template_holder.ab; what it lacks from the CN client, `client: other`). Per enemy id of data/enemies.json and the seasons' enemies.json: prefab root + bundle, modes (UnitMode: _overrideStart/DeadEffect), abilities (GameObject path; emitters castEffects/hitEffects/attachEffects/inputTargetEffects/castTargetEffects with start/end AbilityStandard.Event, oneshot, dir / slots; buffs with overrideEffectKey (fx) and their template effects; projectiles with _mountPointType), points (Graphic mount transforms), giantBoss (an EnemyGiantBoss root: HP panel _bossHudScale.x / _bossHudOffset), hitBox (the root BoxCollider2D: the hit area). Written by tools/local-extract/enemy_bindings.py; the render table goes to public/assets/local/fx/enemy-modes.json.
